info.name: HighBond API Reference Actions Users API

params.name: org_id
params.description: The ID of the HighBond instance.

params.name: filter[user_type]
params.description: Requesting the API to filter Users by their type. Can only be one of the following types `"user"`, `"system"`, and `"root"`

params.name: filter[membership_role]
params.description: Requesting the API to filter Users by their type of membership role in the organization. Can only be one of the following types `"admin"`, and `"member"`

params.name: filter[query]
params.description: Requesting the API to return only Users matching their name or email if it contains the search query string. Case-insensitive.

params.name: page[size]
params.description: The number of items returned per page. Default and maximum is 8000 to support backwards compatibility. Recommended best practice is to use 20-50 for user interface usage, and 100-500 for API usage.

params.name: page[number]
params.description: The page number of records to return. Default is 1.

items.docs:
Get a list of users, excluding system and root users, who are part of a particular HighBond instance.

Additional details: The filters have a priority order and at a time one filter can be applied. The priority is as follows:
1. filter[user_type]
2. filter[query]
3. filter[membership_role]

When multiple filters are passed, the filter with the highest priority is applied.

Note: System and root users are special types of users that act on behalf of the HighBond platform, like in automation tasks
